welcome.headline: One application. Every university in Tanzania.
welcome.signinNote: SERA will never ask you to pay an agent to apply.

dashboard.datesNote: The 2026/27 TCU windows (10 Jul – 10 Aug and 8 – 21 Sep 2026) are closed. Dates are from SERA's October 2026 research. Always check the official site.

aid.intro: Scholarships and loans for Form Six leavers studying in Tanzania. SERA does not award these. Always apply on the official website.
aid.loanText: Apply for the Higher Education Students' Loans Board loan on OLAMS, the official online system.
aid.footnote: Information checked by SERA in October 2026. Rules and dates change, so confirm on the sponsor's website before you apply.

requirements.label: TCU 2026/27
requirements.general: 2 principal passes, total >= 4.0 points in the programme's defining subjects
requirements.note: You apply to each institution on its own admission portal. Check the 2027/28 TCU guidebook, usually out in July, for next year's dates.
